Holistic Dentistry FAQs

items.title: What makes holistic dentistry different from traditional dentistry?

children.html: Holistic dentistry focuses on the connection between oral and overall health, using biocompatible materials and avoiding toxins like mercury and fluoride. It emphasizes prevention, minimally invasive techniques, and whole-body wellness.

items.title: Is holistic dentistry safe for kids and families?

children.html: Yes! Holistic care is ideal for children and families who want natural, gentle treatments without exposure to potentially harmful materials. We also offer fluoride-free options for preventive care.

SMART stands for Safe Mercury Amalgam Removal Technique. It’s a strict protocol for removing old silver fillings while minimizing mercury exposure. We follow guidelines set by the IAOMT to ensure your safety.
Most holistic dentists, including ours, offer fluoride-free alternatives that help remineralize and protect teeth naturally—without synthetic additives.

items.title: Can holistic dental care help with chronic health issues?

children.html: While holistic dentistry doesn’t treat medical conditions, it may support those with autoimmune disorders, allergies, or sensitivities by reducing the toxic burden on the body and promoting overall wellness.

items.title: Are the materials used really that different?

children.html: Yes. We avoid metals, BPA, and other potentially reactive substances. All materials are chosen based on their compatibility with your body and your unique health needs.
